name: Reply Buttons
description: Popup with up to three buttons; each sends its own reply to a topic you choose (two-way home automation, approvals).

permissionReasons.ui: Shows the popup with your reply buttons.
permissionReasons.publish: Sends the reply of the button you press to the topic you chose in the rule.

providers.name: Show reply buttons
providers.description: Popup with 1–3 buttons written as Label=reply; pressing one publishes its reply to the chosen topic.
